verdict.rationale: GitLab's own docs say it applies compliance controls and runs SAST, DAST and compliance in every pipeline, with security findings surfaced directly in merge requests. MR review instructions also set code-review standards. None of the evidence shows these checks can block or gate a merge, or that custom checks can be defined as merge conditions. missing for 10: documented merge-blocking checks or approval rules, definition of custom quality/compliance check conditions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
